== Build notes: 2008 consolation results and source checks ==

Added the Saturday consolation finish of 12th on 5 January 2008 and the Sunday consolation finish of 24th, marked dropped, on 6 January 2008. Both use [[Premiere - Original VS14]] and the source's numbered final standings.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352#p255191 Saturday consolation standings], Players Committee Forums.</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation standings], Players Committee Forums.</ref> Existing deck links, card credits and the earlier Talk note remain.

=== Possibly faulty data: 2014 Philadelphia finish ===
The former finish of 7 is now blank. The general current and recovered historical decklist indexes did not provide the missing 2014 Philadelphia standings. Both genuine individual PC posts confirm James Booker's participation and decks, but leave their Record fields blank.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-james-booker-ds-watto/ James Booker DS Watto], Players Committee, Record field blank.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-philadelphia-premiere-event-james-booker-ls-trm/ James Booker LS TRM], Players Committee, Record field blank.</ref> The event and deck row remains in its existing Open format. No rank was inferred from a decklist position. This does not prove that 7 was false; the supporting placing evidence remains unresolved. The former value and source locators remain in [[Special:PermanentLink/260396|revision 260396]] and its independently backed exact text/provenance ledger.

=== Historical source-copy provenance ===
The old 2012 MPC download-origin byte identity remains unproven. The article now cites the actual readable, independently backed historical Wiki PDF that was checked, page 48: "James Booker's Dark Side List", with ASM first in the handwritten list.<ref>[[:File:2012 Match Play Championship Day 1.pdf|2012 MPC Day 1 historical copy]], p. 48.</ref> This is a citation to the actual copy read, not an assertion of equality with an inaccessible earlier download. The old locator remains in the earlier revision, ledger and the unchanged October Talk note above.

The existing February 2001 Columbus 3rd and Origins constructed 2nd finishes are explicitly printed in the reports' final standings and remain unchanged.<ref>[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-13-columbus-ohio-2-10-01d1729/ Columbus report], final standings: 3. James Booker 4-2.</ref><ref>[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-09-origins-2001-weekend-report-part-1d2602/ Origins weekend report], final standings: 2. Jim Booker 3-0 6(67).</ref> The current archival reconstruction payloads and their measured mirror redirects are preserved as such; they are not labeled original-era HTTP captures. The current original-domain DeckTech recasts were checked separately and are not assumed byte-identical to the later reconstructions.

The four existing photographs, lead choice and full originals are unchanged. Their current public version histories and bytes match the independently restored existing Git originals. Only the gallery captions were shortened to fit the current standard, retaining the named people and event context. The source catalogue heading is now External links. Exact source, draft and live revision backups and central records support publication; captures remain pending under the existing owner, so this does not declare preservation complete.
